what_happened.line: The Open Space Committee voted to recommend that the select board transfer two Lake Shirley parcels to the Parks Commission, subject to town meeting approval.
The vote passed unanimously among members voting; one member's vote was not registered because of technical difficulties.
Members discussed title, encroachments and hand-launch access for the Parmenter Road and Reservoir Road parcels, including whether clear title would open state park grants.
A boundary survey of the Reservoir Road parcel was described as expensive and complicated by boundaries muddied during dam work.
The recommendation will go to the select board with draft minutes, and the chair will seek a place on a select board agenda.

why_it_matters: Moving the parcels to the Parks Commission would put public access to Lake Shirley under the body that can apply for park grants, but it needs town meeting approval, which residents would be asked to vote on.
A survey of these parcels could be requested through the capital plan, so the cost of settling the boundaries may come before the town as a capital request.
watch_next: Select board agenda: the chair will ask to be placed on one, possibly with a subgroup of members attending.
Next committee meetings on December 13 (a placeholder that may be cancelled) and January 10, where the draft minutes are to be approved.
